overview: Welcome to Roof‑ER. Learn our mission, values, leadership, and how we operate as a customer‑first, integrity‑driven team.
learningObjectives: Describe Roof‑ER mission and core values
Understand expectations for professionalism and communication

sections.title: Mission & Values
sections.content:
At ROOFER, our mission is to hold a fiduciary responsibility to our customers, plain and simple. By committing to our core values of integrity, quality, and simplicity, we promise to deliver an experience every homeowner wants when remodeling their home: a simple and straightforward quality installation for a fair and honest price.

**Our Values**
- Integrity — do what’s right, every time
- Quality — premium workmanship and clear communication
- Simplicity — make the process straightforward and stress‑free

**Who We Are**
The Roof Docs began with a simple but powerful idea: homeowners deserve better. What started as a small, tight‑knit team of experts with a shared vision quickly evolved into one of the most trusted names in Northern Virginia. We inspect, educate, and offer the right solution tailored to each homeowner’s unique situation — no scare tactics, no price gouging, just straight talk and sound advice.

sections.title: Leadership Team
sections.content:
Meet the leadership team below. Click a photo to view a short bio.

[BIOS]

leadershipBios.name: Oliver Brown
leadershipBios.title: Owner & Founder, Roof-ER
leadershipBios.bio:
Oliver Brown’s journey in the roofing industry began quite literally on the ground, spending a summer loading shingles onto rooftops under the hot sun. That hands-on experience ignited a passion for the trade and laid the foundation for what would become Roof-ER: a company built on grit, growth, and doing things the right way.

A two-time graduate of Mount St. Mary’s University, Oliver earned his B.S. in Business Marketing in 2013 and an MBA in 2015. Since then, he has combined strategic insight with on-the-job experience to build Roof-ER into a trusted name in exterior remodeling, specializing in roofing, siding, windows, gutters, and solar solutions. Under his leadership, the company has grown through a commitment to integrity, craftsmanship, and treating every homeowner like family.

Oliver leads with a “whatever it takes” mentality and firmly believes that success comes from a mix of hard work, positivity, and a little bit of hustle. Whether he’s working with his team in the field or strategizing for the future, Oliver’s focus is always on delivering excellence while building a company culture rooted in trust and accountability.

Outside the office, Oliver is a passionate sports fan (always ready for a debate), dog owner, and dedicated foodie who never turns down a chance to try something new. And while he’s moved on from his days on the college basketball court, he’ll still claim he has a smoother jumper than most, and he’s more than happy to prove it in any driveway.

From rooftops to boardrooms, Oliver Brown has climbed the ladder with purpose, and he’s just getting started.

leadershipBios.name: Reese Samala
leadershipBios.title: Director of Sales, Roof-ER
leadershipBios.bio:
Reese Samala brings a unique blend of leadership, discipline, and global perspective to his role as Director of Sales at Roof-ER. A first-generation immigrant from the Philippines and a proud U.S. Army Infantryman and Operation Enduring Freedom (OEF) veteran, Reese is driven by a strong sense of service and mission, values that align perfectly with Roof-ER’s commitment to excellence in exterior remodeling.

Reese holds a Bachelor’s degree in Psychology with a Minor in Music from George Mason University and an Executive MBA from Cornell University, where he specialized in leadership, change management, and statistics. His diverse background allows him to connect with customers and teams alike, fostering relationships built on trust, integrity, and performance.

At Roof-ER, Reese leads the sales organization with a sharp strategic mind and a passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences across our core services. His ability to navigate complex projects while motivating high-performing teams has made him an invaluable part of the company’s growth.

Fluent in English, German, and Tagalog (and actively learning several other languages), Reese’s curiosity and global mindset enhance his ability to communicate across cultures and connect with clients from all walks of life. Outside of work, he’s a dedicated family man who enjoys life with his wife Erika and their son Ethan Ryder. In his free time, Reese fuels his passion for high-performance cars, motorcycles of all kinds, and exploring the open road.

With a track record of leadership both in uniform and in business, Reese Samala is a driving force behind Roof-ER’s mission to protect and enhance homes with craftsmanship, care, and cutting-edge solutions.

leadershipBios.name: Ford Barsi
leadershipBios.title: General Manager, Roof-ER
leadershipBios.bio:
As General Manager of Roof-ER, Ford Barsi brings a rare blend of hospitality excellence, operational leadership, and a customer-first mindset that elevates every aspect of the business. Originally from Tampa, Florida, Ford began his career in the fast-paced world of high-end restaurants, starting as a chef in New York City. His passion for food, especially Mexican and Italian cuisine, quickly evolved into a leadership journey that led him to Washington, D.C., where he successfully opened and managed several acclaimed dining establishments.

Ford’s background in hospitality instilled in him a deep appreciation for attention to detail, the value of hard work, and the power of memorable service; principles he now applies to every Roof-ER project. With a Bachelor’s degree in Sociology from the University of Florida, Ford brings both people skills and business savvy to the table, driving growth and team cohesion with a steady hand and strategic vision.

In his role at Roof-ER, Ford oversees day-to-day operations, ensuring that each roofing, siding, window, gutter, or solar project reflects the company’s commitment to quality and care. His leadership style is grounded, approachable, and relentlessly focused on customer satisfaction.

Outside of work, Ford is a proud husband to Kate and father to Olivia. He’s a die-hard Tampa Bay Buccaneers fan (ask him anything, seriously), a Disney enthusiast who takes multiple trips to the parks each year with his family, and a lifelong music lover with a background as a drummer.

Whether managing or mentoring team members, Ford Barsi brings heart, hustle, and hospitality to everything he does, making him an essential part of Roof-ER’s mission to serve homeowners with integrity and excellence.
